description: A Python module defining the MemorizingFile class, which wraps a file object to memorize lines read by readline, with methods to retrieve memorized lines and handle buffering.

classes.name: MemorizingFile
classes.description: A class that wraps a file object to memorize lines read by readline, with buffering and retrieval capabilities.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MemorizingFile with a file object and optional maximum memorized lines.

methods.name: __getattribute__
methods.description: Overrides attribute access to delegate to the wrapped file object for attributes not explicitly handled.

methods.name: readline
methods.description: Reads a line from the file, memorizes it, and handles buffering if size is specified.

methods.name: get_memorized_lines
methods.description: Returns the list of lines that have been memorized so far.
